one_line: Switch asw-a2-codfw became unresponsive, taking down rack A2 hosts and LVS row A links; restrictive depool thresholds caused Restbase/mobileapps/cxserver errors for ~1 hour.
Creation of a ruwikinews category linked from 180k pages triggered reparse jobs running slow DynamicPageList queries, overloading s3 databases and taking down all wikis.
Suspected php-opcache corruption on parse2007 caused fatal errors for ~10% of Parsoid parse/save requests for 9 hours until php-fpm restart.
End-user traffic to Wikifeeds quadrupled, throttling its tls-proxy and causing ~1% 503/504 errors for three days until a pod restart.
Hotlinked large image caused traffic surge to one esams ATS backend; Varnish frontends exhausted work threads, causing 20 minutes of upload media errors.
Patching a new cable to the Equinix IX ports in eqiad caused return-path routing issues, making Wikimedia sites unreachable for some users until IX sessions disabled.
A parser change deployed with the train broke table-of-contents language conversion on Chinese Wikipedia; rollback then removed TOCs due to parser cache incompatibility.
Kernel upgrade on mail server introduced conntrack bug dropping packets to Google, delaying outgoing wikimedia.org mail for about 24 hours.
A firewall configuration change pushed to ulsfo routers cut ulsfo's connectivity to other POPs and core sites for 3 minutes until rolled back.
Misbehaving k8s node kubernetes1014 cost the flink session cluster a pod, starving slots and stopping the eqiad WDQS streaming updater for 7 hours, throttling edits.
Stuck generate_otrs_aliases timer on mx2001 failed to update VRTS aliases, causing intermittent 550 rejects for new dcw@wikimedia.org queue.
Flink updater upgrade in codfw failed to restore savepoint due to poor swift client implementation, stalling WDQS updates and blocking bot edits via maxlag.
Multiple redundant network providers for a datacenter lost connectivity simultaneously; after 20 minutes clients were rerouted to other datacenters via DNS depool.
A CentralNotice banner enabled for all users with 100% event sampling flooded Varnish with beacon traffic to eventgate, making wikis unreachable in Esams regions.
WDQS Blazegraph in eqiad overloaded and blocked client traffic including Pybal, causing paging outage; resolved by clusterwide wdqs restarts.
Incident possibly related to stopping MySQL with buffer pool dump between MariaDB 10.4 versions; report gives few details.
An itwiki template edit triggered mass transclusion updates; changeprop and mobileapps flooded the API cluster with reparse requests, exhausting PHP-FPM workers.
WDQS codfw Blazegraph deadlocked while eqiad was depooled, causing outage until services were restarted.
Train-deployed CentralAuth GlobalUsersPager change caused expensive queries on s7 replicas, tying up API PHP-FPM workers; slow queries killed, patches reverted.
An outage at the Amsterdam Internet Exchange (AMS-IX) platform caused connectivity issues affecting Wikimedia sites.
A Telia fiber cut followed by Telia maintenance took down all Eqord transports, making Eqord network equipment unreachable; no end-user impact.
Expired etcd.eqiad TLS certificate on conf hosts' nginx broke conftool-data sync in eqiad; paged by etcd replication lag, fixed with new cergen certificate.
An erroneous rm -rf deleted parts of /srv/deployment on deploy1002, halting deployments until restored from Bacula backup.
A GlobalBlocking schema change made MariaDB pick a slow plan for s7 globalblocks, stalling app servers until rolled back.
A confctl depool command with an invalid selector was applied to all hosts and depooled most codfw services, causing edge errors until repooled.
Exim rejected ~14,000 Gmail emails with 503 BDAT/CHUNKING errors for five days until users reported bounces; disabling chunking mitigated it.
Slow database responses from a likely MariaDB 10.6 performance regression under load exhausted app server workers, causing brief uncached traffic latency/unavailability twice.
A flood of API traffic from an AWS instance overloaded caching servers, making services behind the caching layer unreachable though still up.
Puppet change made Apache listen on 443 regardless of mod_ssl, causing apache2 failures across MediaWiki and other hosts until manually fixed.
Surge of POST requests to de.wikipedia.org root URLs overloaded s5 DB, saturating php-fpm workers and causing 503s and latency; self-resolved quickly.
Faulty memory caused db1128, m1 MariaDB primary, to reboot, making internal services like Bacula and Etherpad unavailable for ~12 minutes.
Full /srv on an-master1002 stopped standby NameNode fsimage saves, so JournalNode partitions filled and HDFS NameNodes crashed.
A reimage operation caused the cloudelastic Elasticsearch cluster to lose a shard (red status). Search results stayed incomplete until a month-delayed restore was completed on 12 July.
Large volume of Varnish HTTP 429 rate-limit responses overloaded HAProxy, causing HTTP 503s and general service disruption.
Report contains only a status page link; no details about what happened, its cause, or how it was detected.
Debug print statements on labtestwikitech leaked database credentials to web clients; password rotated after an engineer noticed, taking 60-90 minutes.
Scheduled power maintenance on codfw rack A1 took down its network switch due to a loose second power cable; redundancy limited impact.
During power maintenance, a cable was bumped causing full power loss to the A4 codfw rack switch, dropping connectivity; minimal user impact.
A surge of Parsoid Score (musical notation) requests from de.wikipedia overwhelmed Shellbox, causing slow requests and 503/504 errors; mitigated by adding k8s pods.
API request spike exhausted PHP workers and db1132 (MariaDB 10.6) connections, raising latency and errors; auto-recovered, root cause unclear.
VisualEditor Score preview debounce caused frequent Lilypond shellouts via Shellbox, overloading it and triggering ProbeDown pages; Parsoid and mobileapps also affected.
During PDU upgrade maintenance in codfw rack A5, CyrusOne flipped the wrong breaker, cutting both power feeds and taking all rack servers down.

incident: Incidents/2022-07-13 brief outbound bandwidth spike eqsin
one_line: A brief outbound bandwidth spike for upload in eqsin recovered by itself; details are restricted.
Switch asw2-c-eqiad virtual chassis lost FPC5, taking rack C5 hosts down and causing network instability; some services needed manual recovery.
Planned Codfw power maintenance shut down Cassandra hosts; remaining hosts filled disks with hinted-handoff logs, resolved by restoring nodes early.
A Puppet change accidentally installed confd on many production hosts, causing widespread Puppet failures; installs were cleaned up via Cumin with no user impact.
Inadvertent restart of WMCS cloudvirts left all Beta Cluster sites returning 502 errors until trafficserver was restarted.
Operators skipping statements to fix broken x2 replication broke local replicas; ChronologyProtector blocked MainStash writes, exposing a MediaWiki bug causing user-facing editing errors.
Report is an unfilled template with no details about the incident, its cause, or how it was detected.
Testing an ATS cookie-handling puppet change on cp6016 stripped session cookies, breaking Phabricator logins until reverted; reported by users on IRC.
Nginx update on conf1009 restarted etcd tlsproxy, crashing etcdmirror on conf2005; deployment depooled appservers, and etcdmirror restart synced depools to 50% of codfw servers.
Elasticsearch 7 upgrade changes broke search autocomplete results after caches expired; editors reported it, mitigated by falling back to prefix search.
After reimaging a sessionstore Cassandra node, Kask (gocql bug) failed to recognise it, falsely losing quorum and disrupting wiki sessions and logins.
Report is an unfilled template with no incident details; cause, impact, and detection are unknown.
A configuration change pushed to cr1-eqiad during planned uplink work discarded row D traffic until an automatic two-minute rollback.
s6 master db1131 crashed from a failing DIMM, making s6 wikis read-only until power-cycled; later failed over to db1173.
Spam wave to VRTS (otrs1001) spawned Perl processes exhausting RAM; OOM killed clamav, halting mail delivery and filling mx1001 queue.
A MediaWiki bug made dumps snapshot hosts hammer etcd on conf hosts, generating log spam that filled conf1008's disk; dumps paused and fix merged.
Swift media file backend returned errors for reads and uploads for 49 minutes; resolved by restarting swift-proxy on frontends and repooling hosts.
Connecting a new server to eqsin top of rack switches triggered a Juniper bug causing a process crash and traffic interruption.
Gerrit upgrade to 3.5.4 filled the root partition during reindexing, causing write failures until data was relocated to a dedicated partition.
A single bad query likely overloaded Blazegraph-based WDQS in eqiad, causing 15+ minutes of failed or slow queries until hosts were restarted.
MediaWiki 1.40.0-wmf.13 train change made REST API serve current revision for old revision requests, breaking visual diffs; fixed by rollback and backport.
Increased MediaWiki logging congested eventgate-analytics and starved api appservers of idle workers; no user impact.
Request influx exhausted codfw Blazegraph thread pools, triggering a known deadlock bug; most codfw WDQS requests failed until self-healing.
A wrong configuration change made sessionstore pods unschedulable in WikiKube, causing failed edits across all projects for 9 minutes.
A 50% traffic increase during the World Cup combined with DiscussionTools API calls overloaded eqiad API servers, detected by automated monitoring alerts.
A sudden request spike, likely from jobrunners, overloaded shellbox-syntaxhighlight; it was mitigated by scaling it from 12 to 40 replicas.
Alertmanager SMS alerted SREs to an issue likely caused by unthrottled onLinksUpdateComplete checking commons file usage, resolved by DBA depooling a server.
Provider planned maintenance took down eqsin's second transport link while the first was cut, isolating eqsin; site depooled after ~11 minutes.
Switch asw-b2-codfw failed, taking all B2 rack hosts offline; swift and thanos frontends depooled, running with reduced redundancy until replacement.
Backport deployment left extension.json applied before php-fpm restart picked up PHP code, crashing MediaWiki for all logged-in page views until reverted.
Prep work for replacing codfw row B switch triggered Junos bugs, destabilizing row B and breaking IPv6 connectivity, requiring service depools and onsite work.
Routine reboot of Cassandra host sessionstore1001 caused LOCAL_QUORUM errors after rejoining, causing session loss and failed edits until Kask was restarted.
Kartotherian upgrade triggered spurious Icinga alerts; rollback without --env flag broke fragile config templates, causing a maps outage until redeployed correctly.
A flood of Parsoid PHP notice exceptions caused Kafka consumer lag in eqiad Logstash, unnoticed on a Saturday, consuming 160% of quarterly latency SLO budget.
A logical bug in a switchover test script accidentally set the secondary datacenter to read-only mode, disabling mobile editing until reported by users.
During HAProxy upgrade maintenance, all ATS backends in esams and eqiad text cache were accidentally depooled, causing ~17M errored requests.
MariaDB 10.6.10 query killer bug left db1127 overloaded, saturating api_appserver PHP-FPM workers; host was depooled to recover.
During planned GitLab datacenter switchover, the daily restore job stayed enabled on the new codfw production host, restoring a backup and losing ~2 hours of data.
During eqiad row A switch maintenance, Mailman's out runner crashed on DB connection loss; outgoing mail queued for ~2 days despite unnoticed Icinga alert.

incident: Incidents/2023-05-02 Phabricator outage during GitLab maintenance
one_line: Planned GitLab datacenter switch maintenance made Phabricator tasks fail to load due to a GitLab patches widget not handling GitLab unavailability.

incident: Incidents/2023-05-05 prometheus down in ulsfo and eqsin
one_line: Prometheus Buster-to-Bullseye migration copied corrupted WAL/chunks_head files, leaving Prometheus down for 8 hours in two data centers, losing observability.

incident: Incidents/2023-05-05 wdqs not updating in codfw
one_line: rdf-streaming-updater in CODFW became unstable and stopped sending updates, causing stale WDQS/WCQS data; alerts fired but weren't treated urgently.
An external user repeatedly sending an expensive query caused WDQS errors and timeouts in CODFW; mitigated with a requestctl rule.
Replication broke on sanitarium hosts db1154/db1155 (likely MariaDB bug), stalling wikireplicas for days; sections were downgraded and recloned to recover.

incident: Incidents/2023-06-18 search broken on wikidata and commons
one_line: Routine Elasticsearch reindex de-duplicated analyzers; token_count_router still referenced removed text_search analyzer, breaking fulltext search on Wikidata and Commons until one-line fixes deployed.
mw-page-content-change-enrich stalled when messages exceeded Kafka's maximum message size, degrading SLIs; the application was manually restarted and caught up on consumer lag.

incident: Incidents/2023-08-09 mw-on-k8s outage due to wrong tls cert
one_line: A global k8s defaults change switched to cert-manager certificates, so the next MediaWiki-on-k8s deployment used wrong TLS certs, failing mw-api probes.
Wrong YARN log aggregation compression value ('gzip' instead of 'gz') on re-imaged Hadoop workers broke log retrieval, failing Airflow tasks.
After DC switchover, RESTBase more_like search queries sent as POST routed to codfw, overloading an Elasticsearch node and delaying on-wiki search.
After DC switchover depooled thanos-swift from eqiad, misconfigured egress rules made mw-page-content-change-enrich flink app fail to start in passive eqiad.
Kafka partition reassignment to new brokers caused the mw-page-content-change-enrich Flink job to fail producing to Kafka; backlog cleared after increasing parallelism.

incident: Incidents/2023-09-29 CloudVPS vms losing network connectivity
one_line: A puppet package-cleanup patch removed isc-dhcp-client from bullseye Cloud VPS VMs; expiring DHCP leases cut network connectivity, taking down proxies, metricsinfra and NFS.
An engineer accidentally rebooted a linecard on cr1-esams (wrong router), making the ESAMS datacenter unreachable for about 10 minutes and dropping global requests.
Over 1,000 consecutive non-conftool etcd events from Spicerack cookbook locks exceeded etcd v2 event retention, breaking etcd-mirror replication eqiadâ†’codfw; fixed by manually advancing index.
Decommissioning too many Elasticsearch hosts at once, including omega masters, broke a small cluster in the inactive datacenter; aborted cookbook still wiped a master.
Deploying mw-mcrouter daemonset in eqiad used a non-dot-terminated FQDN, tripling DNS queries and OOM-killing CoreDNS, breaking MediaWiki pods until depool and revert.

incident: Incidents/2024-04-26 Search unavailable for some eqiad users
one_line: New elastic hosts in racks E5/F5 were unreachable from LVS because new rack vlans were never configured on load-balancers, causing search errors.

incident: Incidents/2024-04-28 WMCS Toolforge Redis refusing connections
one_line: Toolforge Redis intermittently refused connections for an hour due to max clients reached; resolved by failover and manual restart.
Failed MediaWiki deployment caused by CPU and network saturation on Kubernetes API servers exacerbated by OpenTelemetry collector traffic.
Hotlinking of a Commons image caused outbound link saturation in eqsin; mitigated by a varnish frontend rule returning HTTP 429.

incident: Incidents/2024-06-10 puppet volatile data broken sync
one_line: Rsync clients syncing puppet volatile data from puppetmaster1001 hung indefinitely for six weeks due to no timeouts, leaving GeoIP data stale, especially in codfw.
Faulty optic on WMCS inter-rack fiber link caused packet loss in Ceph cluster, stalling storage writes and making Cloud VPS services inaccessible.

incident: Incidents/2024-06-12 WMCS toolforge k8s control plane
one_line: System-wide renaming of Kyverno policies overloaded Toolforge Kubernetes control nodes, making the API unresponsive and preventing rollback.

incident: Incidents/2024-06-21 - 2024-06-24 Outage Incidents - Dumps Generation Issues
one_line: Full dumps pressured databases, causing MediaWiki DB errors whose UDP log flood overwhelmed the network and took the wikis down.

incident: Incidents/2024-07-21 s4 and x1 write overload
one_line: s4 database section overload cascaded to x1, triggering circuit breaking and 5XX errors on MediaWiki API until write load was reduced.
Scap deploy of phatality plugin failed to remove old version due to sudo check failure, causing duplicate plugin fatal error on all logstash dashboards.
Setting up circular replication before the datacenter switchover broke ROW-based x1 and es replication over missing heartbeat rows.
DIMM error on parser cache host pc1013 crashed MariaDB repeatedly; failed over to spare pc1015, causing degraded performance from cold cache.
Core router cr2-eqsin failed due to hardware (disk) failure; recovery slowed when it loaded an outdated rescue config; eqsin depooled to restore access.
Batch transcode requeue via mwscript-k8s created ~1.8k jobs and Calico network policies, overloading Calico in codfw WikiKube and causing cascading node failures.

incident: Incidents/2024-10-24 codfw pc and kafka mirrormaker issues
one_line: Parser cache p2 in codfw saturated with connections from a template-driven reparse surge and a scraper, on hosts lacking the query killer.
Known Puppet bug removed nameserver from resolv.conf and nginx configs on proxy-04, causing nginx to fail; paged, fixed by restoring resolv.conf.
Puppet change to OpenStack OVS config restarted neutron agents, interrupting VM networking and breaking Toolforge NFS and Kubernetes DNS resolution.

incident: Incidents/2024-12-03 Port saturation from cached Varnish HEAD-GET upgrades
one_line: WME HEAD requests converted to cached GETs by ATS saturated eqiad switch links; changing ATS caching for WME IPs reduced traffic.
Incoming traffic overwhelmed Gerrit, making it inaccessible to all users; ProbeDown alert fired and an engineer manually paged SRE.
Shifting Kartotherian traffic to Kubernetes, which lacked the LVS loopback address, overloaded the remaining bare-metal capacity.
Pooling Kubernetes workers back into Kartotherian, whose TLS certificate lacked the maps.wikimedia.org name, sent about 31,000 requests to 50x errors.
A WikimediaCampaignEvents extension change deployed to production raised WDQS query failures for about 40 minutes; reverting it restored normal levels.
Incorrect Apache config deploy caused infinite redirect on www.wikipedia.org; impact grew gradually as CDN caches expired, reported by users on social media.
Monthly reconcile DAG produced 6.3M extra events, causing Flink taskmanager OOMs and pipeline failure; fixed by adding replicas and doubling memory.
PHP 8.1 scap rollout left mw-api-int, parsoid, jobrunner without Memcached access, overloading External Storage databases and causing high latency and errors.
Excessive downloads of .tiff files overloaded Swift in eqiad, causing latency and errors on upload.wikimedia.org until traffic was throttled.
Aberrant high-rate session overwrites filled sessionstore Cassandra disks, crashing nodes and losing quorum; edits failed until storage was wiped.
During Gerrit switchover from gerrit2002 to gerrit1003, both hosts acted as primary, replicating stale state and corrupting two repositories, causing five hours of downtime.
Train wmf.27 removed transitional Cite CSS rule; stale footnote styles copied into mobileapps conflicted with new localized HTML markers, breaking footnotes for users.

A buggy automated script expanding security group rules for IPv6 deleted existing rules instead of updating them, causing outages across cloud-vps services including Toolforge, Quarry, and Prometheus/Grafana.
Papal election announcement drove record 800k req/s traffic; esams IPVS load balancers overloaded, causing ~10 minutes of errors for some European users.
Wikipedia search bar autocomplete returned unexpected results; community reported it, alerts did not fire, and traffic was routed away from EQIAD.
During bulk decommissioning of CirrusSearch/OpenSearch nodes, node banning failed, destabilizing the cluster and streaming updater; datacenter was depooled so no user impact.

incident: Incidents/2025-06-30 eventgate-analytics has stopped producing events

one_line: OpenSearch cluster lost quorum (no cluster leader, 503s) after master-eligible replacement procedure wasn't followed during migration; traffic failed over quickly.

incident: Incidents/2025-07-11 WMCS Ceph issues causing Toolforge and Cloud VPS failures
one_line: Ceph hosts upgraded to Debian Bookworm misbehaved intermittently, taking down Toolforge tools and Cloud VPS VMs until downgraded back to Bullseye.

incident: Incidents/2025-07-17 Cite + VisualEditor list-defined reference disappearances
one_line: A Cite extension change omitted a list item ID in VisualEditor serialization, causing Parsoid to drop list-defined references on save; reverted and backported.
OpenSearch cluster lost quorum (no cluster leader, 503s) after master-eligible replacement procedure wasn't followed during migration; traffic failed over quickly.
All WDQS codfw Blazegraph servers deadlocked simultaneously, leaving no healthy LVS pool hosts and causing 500 errors on query.wikidata.org; root cause unknown.
From 22:45 UTC on 4 Nov 2025, Wikidata Query Service on CODFW was slow, erroring, or timing out; bots editing Wikidata were throttled.

incident: Incidents/2025-11-05 WMCS toolsdb primary out of space
one_line: ToolsDB ran out of disk space as ibdata1 grew uncontrollably on tools-db-4, breaking tool connections; users reported it as no write-check alert existed.
A WAF rate-limit rule was mistakenly set to global throttling instead of per-IP, rate-limiting users until an engineer noticed a 429 and reverted it.
ToolsDB primary crashed (cause unclear, possibly load from undo logs after prior crash); engineer logged in noticed and failed over to replica in ~10 minutes.
K8s 1.31 upgrade of ML clusters brought Istio 1.24, whose stricter VirtualService host validation broke transparent-proxy model servers, causing 5XX errors.
Report is an unfilled template with no incident details; cause, detection, and impact are not described.
